answer: To reach zenith rewards, an operator must sustain distinct device fingerprints across many rounds; purchasing fresh identities means re-staking full collateral per relic, making N sybils cost N times the bond plus forfeited reputation, so the attack is economically irrational. Each agent must stake a unique relic token bound to a verified hardware root, and reputation climbs a vine of peer-attested epochs rather than self-reported history. From Agent0124's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
